definitions.explanation: Rain that falls during autumn, or the rainy period in autumn (typically September to October in Japan). Also refers to the autumn rain front (秋雨前線).

examples.japanese: {秋雨|あきさめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}いている→降り続く：21878_furitsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The autumn rain continues to fall.

examples.japanese: {秋雨|あきさめ}{前線|ぜんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れた→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧。
examples.english: The weather worsened due to the autumn rain front.

examples.japanese: {秋雨|あきさめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{下|さ}がり→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れ→訪れ：14267_otozure⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: When the autumn rain season arrives, the temperature drops noticeably and you can feel winter approaching.

notes:
WEATHER:
The {秋雨|あきさめ}{前線|ぜんせん} (autumn rain front) is a weather pattern that brings extended rain to Japan from late August through October, similar to the ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}{前線|ぜんせん}→梅雨前線：24972_tsuyuzensen⟧ (rainy season front) in early summer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秋雨|あきさめ}{前線|ぜんせん} (autumn rain front)
- {秋雨|あきさめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ (autumn rain season)
- {秋雨|あきさめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧ (autumn rain falls)

RELATED WORDS:
- {春雨|はるさめ}: spring rain
- ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧: rainy season (June–July)
- ⟦{時雨|しぐれ}→時雨：30753_shigure⟧: late autumn/early winter drizzle
